tasks.label: Serve
tasks.detail: Dev server with live reload at http://localhost:4000

tasks.label: New draft
tasks.detail: Creates _drafts/<title>.md with the site's front matter

tasks.label: New post
tasks.detail: Creates a post in _posts/ dated today, skipping drafts

tasks.label: Publish open draft
tasks.detail: Moves the draft open in the editor into _posts/ with today's date

tasks.label: Unpublish open post
tasks.detail: Moves the post open in the editor back to _drafts/

tasks.label: Check
tasks.detail: Production build plus the deploy's link check (builds into _site-check so a running server isn't disturbed)
tasks.command: bundle exec jekyll build -d _site-check && bundle exec htmlproofer _site-check --disable-external --ignore-urls '/^http:\/\/127.0.0.1/,/^http:\/\/0.0.0.0/,/^http:\/\/localhost/'
